title: Rashke Maryam naaze Saara Sayyeda
body:
Rashke Maryam naaze Saara Sayyeda
rashke maryam naze sara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko yeh maalum hai jannat me bhi
aap hi kaa hai ijaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
hauslaa zainab ka allaho ghani
aa gayi jaise dubaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
rotiyo par aapki hai aajtak
arsh walo ka guzara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
aate aate aapke darbaar tak
bhar gaya daaman humaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
dono aalam me nahi jiski misaal
aisa qunbaa hai tumhaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mei haider k hua jalwaa figan
teri kismat ka sitaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
baadshaho ne teri aulaad se
maanga bakshish ka sahaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
<<DIVIDER>>
zulme duniya khamoshi se ai abad
kar gayi kaise gawaara sayyada
<<MINI>>
mustafa ke dilka paara sayyada
author: Ali Safdar
